#DROP TABLE IF EXISTS s_cmi_summary_drg;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_cmi_summary_drg (
	`id` VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL,
	`hospcode` VARCHAR(5) NOT NULL,
	`areacode` VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL,
	`flag_sent` VARCHAR(1) DEFAULT NULL,
	`date_com` VARCHAR(17) DEFAULT NULL,
	`b_year` VARCHAR(4) NOT NULL,
	`drg` VARCHAR(5) NOT NULL,
	`sumcntan` DECIMAL(42,0) DEFAULT NULL,
	`sumadjrw` DOUBLE DEFAULT NULL,
	`hospname` VARCHAR(255) DEFAULT NULL,
	`chwcode` VARCHAR(2) DEFAULT NULL,
	`chwname` VARCHAR(255) DEFAULT NULL,
	`region` VARCHAR(2) DEFAULT NULL,
	`splevel` VARCHAR(2) DEFAULT NULL,
	`cntq1` BIGINT(23) DEFAULT NULL,
	`sumq1` DOUBLE DEFAULT NULL,
	`cntq2` BIGINT(23) DEFAULT NULL,
	`sumq2` DOUBLE DEFAULT NULL,
	`cntq3` BIGINT(23) DEFAULT NULL,
	`sumq3` DOUBLE DEFAULT NULL,
	`cntq4` BIGINT(23) DEFAULT NULL,
	`sumq4` DOUBLE DEFAULT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,b_year,drg)
) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8;
DELETE FROM s_cmi_summary_drg WHERE id=@id AND b_year=@b_year;

INSERT IGNORE INTO s_cmi_summary_drg (`id`,`hospcode`,`areacode`,`flag_sent`,`date_com`,	`b_year`,
`drg`,`sumcntan`,`sumadjrw`,`hospname`,`chwcode`,`chwname`,`region`,`splevel`,
`cntq1`,`sumq1`,`cntq2`,`sumq2`,`cntq3`,`sumq3`,`cntq4`,`sumq4`)
select @id as id, t.hospcode
, concat(h.provcode, h.distcode, h.subdistcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) as areacode
, @send as flag_sent, DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i') as date_com, (@b_year+543) as b_year
, t.drg, sum(t.cntan) as sumcntan, sum(t.sumadj) as sumadjrw
, t.hname as hospname, t.chwcode, t.chwname, t.region, t.splevel
, (t.cntm10+t.cntm11+t.cntm12) as cntq1, (t.adjm10+t.adjm11+t.adjm12) as sumq1
, (t.cntm01+t.cntm02+t.cntm03) as cntq2, (t.adjm01+t.adjm02+t.adjm03) as sumq2
, (t.cntm04+t.cntm05+t.cntm06) as cntq3, (t.adjm04+t.adjm05+t.adjm06) as sumq3
, (t.cntm07+t.cntm08+t.cntm09) as cntq4, (t.adjm07+t.adjm08+t.adjm09) as sumq4
from t_cmi_admission t
join chospital h on t.hospcode = h.hoscode
join ccmi51drg m on t.drg = m.drg
group by t.hospcode, t.drg;

SELECT 
			c.drg as a_code
			,CONCAT(c.drg,' ', c.drgname) as a_name
      , sum(sumcntan) as sumcntall
      , sum(sumadjrw) as sumadjrw
       , sum(cntq1) as cntq1
      , sum(sumq1) as sumq1
      , sum(cntq2) as cntq2
      , sum(sumq2) as sumq2
      , sum(cntq3) as cntq3
      , sum(sumq3) as sumq3
      , sum(cntq4) as cntq4
      , sum(sumq4) as sumq4
FROM	ccmi51drg as c	INNER JOIN 
	( 
	SELECT *  FROM	{tablename} as s {jointable} {joinwith} 
	WHERE  s.id='{reportid}' AND s.b_year = '{year}' 
	) as s ON c.drg =s.drg  
WHERE 1=1 {where}
GROUP BY	1
